english.note: Use 局 for a Hong Kong-style government bureau or department when it has that official institutional status.
Use this for a government bureau or an institutional information bureau, especially when it is an official department.

examples.english: The Transport Department announced that fares will increase next week.
examples.traditional: 運輸局宣布下星期起加價。
examples.jyutping: wan6 syu1 guk6 syun1 bou3 haa6 sing1 kei4 hei2 gaa1 gaa3

examples.english: Residents can go to the transport bureau to apply for a licence.
examples.traditional: 市民可以去運輸局申請牌照。
examples.jyutping: si5 man4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 wan6 syu1 guk6 san1 cing2 paai4 ziu3

english.note: Use 局 for a particular round or game, especially the technical game segment in racket sports.

examples.english: You served really well in this game.
examples.jyutping: ni1 guk6 nei5 faat3 kau4 faat3 dak1 hou2 leng3
